HOW THIS WAS BUILT (checked 2026-09-25)
- Series and models come from HP's own support data. support.hp.com pages are JavaScript apps, so WebFetch got HTTP 503 or an empty page. The data those pages load was fetched directly from HP's JSON endpoints on support.hp.com: /wcc-services/searchresult (series search) and /wcc-services/productdata/version/<locale>?seriesid=<id> (the model list the support site shows for a series). A WebFetch of one of these URLs (7300 series) returned the same names. HP's robots.txt disallows /wcc-services for crawlers. This was a one-off, rate-limited lookup of about 150 requests, not a crawl.
- The series list is complete for HP support: HP's published sitemap (https://support.hp.com/sitemap/contextual/pdp-product-specs-0.xml, all 88 buckets) has exactly the same 27 HP Smart Tank series as the search. Each series appears in every support locale (about 70), so support-locale presence says nothing about where a model is sold. It was not used for regions.
- Series names are HP's exact support names, e.g. "HP Smart Tank 7300 series", not "... All-in-One Printer series". HP names the 580 group "HP Smart Tank 580 All-in-One Printer".
- Model name = HP's model name without the "All-in-One", "Wireless All-in-One" or "Printer" suffix. The prefixes Plus, Pro and Wireless are kept because HP uses them in the name (e.g. "HP Smart Tank Wireless 455", "HP Smart Tank Pro 9125r").
- "HP Smart Tank 5000": HP support lists this model as "HP Smart Tank 5000/5100 All-in-One Printer" (SKU 5D1B6A). The same SKU is sold on the HP Canada store as "hp-smart-tank-5000-...-5d1b6a", and hp.com/us-en names "HP Smart Tank 5000 All-in-One". It is recorded as number 5000. The separate "HP Smart Tank 5100 All-in-One Printer" model (SKU 9B2D5A) is its own entry.
- "e" aliases (7001e, 7002e, 7006e, 7301e, 7302e, 7601e, 7602e, 7605e, 7606e): HP's br-pt, mx-es and cn-zh support data give these same model IDs names ending in "e" (HP+ variants), and the US HP Store sitemap uses 7001e and 7301e. They are aliases of the base model, not separate models.
- The "r" models (4905r, 6001r, 7602r, Pro 9125r) are separate HP series and models. Their base number without "r" is not an alias.
- Excluded: "HP DesignJet Smart Tank T858 / T908 / T918". HP support lists these under HP DesignJet Printers (a large-format line), not HP Smart Tank Printers.

REGIONS (strict: a region is recorded only when an hp.com page for that country names the model)
- Evidence used, in order of strength: (1) an HP Store product page I opened whose title names the model: BR, MX, AR, CL, CO, PE, MY, SG, TH and NZ with curl, IN with WebFetch; (2) the hp.com/<country>/printers/smart-tank.html page naming the exact model: US, GB, AU, BR; (3) for US and CA only, an HP Store sitemap listing the model's product page. The US and CA store product pages themselves failed (HTTP/2 reset, 503, or redirect to the home page), so those regions rely on HP's sitemap entries and may include recently delisted items.
- Store pages that redirected to a listing or home page (e.g. Smart Tank 519 in CO/PE, 500 in CL/TH/ID) were NOT counted.
- An empty regions array means no hp.com country page confirming sale was found. It does not mean the model is not sold anywhere. Many regional models (e.g. the 510/590/670 families, sold mainly in Asia, Africa and EMEA) have no online HP Store listing.
- Smart Tank Wireless 455/457 appear on the HP Mexico store only as supply-compatibility filters, so MX was not recorded for them.

DISCONTINUED: No HP page opened marks any Smart Tank model as discontinued. HP support still lists every model here, including old ones (350, Wireless 450, 500 and 510 series). discontinued=false means "not marked discontinued", not "confirmed current".

INK TANK: The 4 HP Ink Tank series and 18 models come from the same HP support data (110, 310, Wireless 410, and "Wireless 415 All-in-One Mirror Printers"). Regions come only from opened HP Store product pages. hpstore.cn (China) lists Ink Tank 319/410/419 in HP's sitemap, but those pages did not open, so CN was not recorded. No number is used by both lines: Ink Tank uses 115-119, 310-319 and 410-419, and Smart Tank has none of these.

BLOCKED OR FAILED DOMAINS: support.hp.com HTML pages (503 or empty JS shell over WebFetch; JSON endpoints worked); www.hp.com/us-en/shop (HTTP/2 reset, WebFetch 503); www.hp.com/ca-en/shop and ca-fr/shop product pages (redirect to home, WebFetch 503); hpstore.cn (connection failed); amazon.com (503); walmart.com (bot check); bestbuy.com (results would not load); staples.com (403). target.com and costco.com were not tried because no candidate pages were found. A headless browser was not usable: the sandbox proxy certificate is not trusted by Chromium.
